name: grid-subgrid-stage-orthogonal-adjustment
derivation: Orthogonal reversal of the same physical-axis dependency: A is horizontal; B and C are vertical-lr. B's local rows inherit A's physical columns, while B's local columns are standalone. C's local columns inherit B's physical-y columns and C's local rows are standalone max-content tracks. Grid 12.1 requires A's physical-x sizing first, hence B/C local ROW sizing before their local COLUMN sizing, reversing independent vertical-grid order. The horizontal 20x30 marker supplies an initial physical-x contribution of 20px; the empty ratio item's 100% physical height is unresolved against the infinite auto-track approximation. The physical-y pass sizes B's standalone column to 30px and C inherits it. The 2:1 ratio item now contributes 60px horizontally, so the single physical-x adjustment changes C's local row and A's column to 60px. The second-axis check leaves 30px unchanged. Vertical-lr gives a left-to-right block axis, so all origins remain zero. The ratio item is explicitly horizontal, avoiding an intrinsic orthogonal text-layout policy. Coordinates are parent-relative.
